description: Rank any number of cities for a person or household: a verdict, the score out of 100 from their weights with points and reasons per line, must-pass lines as pass, fail or unknown, each earner's take-home pay and what is left after rent and spending, who can move there, how the set was scored, and what to add next. Every figure carries its source and period. Compact by default; detail "full" adds every tax line, childcare, health, leave and break-even.

amount.description: Amount, in the city's own currency

per.description: What the amount is for: a month or a year

childcareCost.description: What the household actually pays for childcare in a city, after support, keyed by city id or name, in the city's currency, with per "month" or "year": replaces the OECD reference figure

children.description: Children's ages: childcare after public support for under-6s (OECD), child credits and allowances where the tax uses them, health for each person

cities.description: City ids (e.g. turin-it) or names in any common spelling (Turin, Torino, 'Paris, FR'); a name two places share needs its country

comfort.description: Comfortable daytime temperature for the Nice days line, °C: a dry, mostly clear day whose average from 8 am to 8 pm is inside it counts. Default 18-30 on the feels-like temperature; basis "air" uses the air temperature in the shade

dealBreakers.description: Must-pass criterion ids, e.g. right_to_live, money_left: a city fails, passes, or is unknown (no figure, a passport not given); unknown ranks after every city that passes

detail.description: "summary" (default): verdict, ranking, weighted lines with citations, money in brief, who can move there, notes, required unknowns and next inputs. "full": every line, tax line and source, for programs

displayCurrency.description: Currency to show amounts in (default: the salary's, else EUR)

amount.description: Amount, in the city's own currency

per.description: What the amount is for: a month or a year

healthPremium.description: The household's health insurance premium bought outside pay (US, CH, NL), keyed by city id or name, in the city's currency, with per "month" or "year" (a year is counted as a twelfth a month)

household.description: Everyone moving, you first. Anyone after you can bring their own pay; a spouse counts for joint filing even with none

age.description: Age in years: age-dependent tax (youth relief, care insurance), pension caps, paid leave, newcomer regimes

passports.description: ISO alpha-2 codes, e.g. ['IT','US'], if known. Leave out when you do not know them: that person's right to live there is then reported as not checked, never as needing a visa

pension.description: This person's pension share of gross, 0.05 = 5%

regimeConfirmations.description: This person's answers to newcomer-regime conditions no dataset can check, by condition id (list_metrics_and_sources kind "regimes"), e.g. {"nl-recruited-abroad": true}. Only what the person told you

regimes.description: Not for the first person (use `regimes`): newcomer regimes this person chose, ISO alpha-2 -> regime id, checked against this person's own facts and confirmations; a scenario until they meet every condition

relation.description: Partner decides couple vs single-parent childcare

salary.description: Not for the first person (use `salary`): this person's gross yearly pay, the same everywhere

currency.description: ISO 4217, e.g. EUR, GBP, USD. Default: the display currency
ISO 4217, e.g. EUR, GBP, USD. Default: the display currency

salaryByCity.description: Not for the first person: this person's gross per city, keyed by city id or name

spouse.description: Married to (or registered partner of) the first person: joint filing where the country has it, applied when it is required or cheaper

yearsSinceResident.description: Whole years since last tax resident there, by ISO alpha-2, or 'never': for newcomer regimes

limit.description: How many ranked cities to describe in the summary (default 10); the ranking counts the rest

missing.description: A city without a figure on a line: "lowest" (default) scores it as the lowest compared city, "worst" as 0, "skip" leaves the line out for every city. Money is never filled in either way

only.description: Score only these criteria; every other line gets weight 0 (each listed one keeps its `weights` value, else 100). For a one-line question: only ["nice_days"] with comfort {min:20,max:28}

overrides.description: Your own numbers: city -> metric id -> value; money in the city's currency. health_premium is the household's premium a month (prefer healthPremium, which takes the period); childcare_cost is the household's own childcare a month (prefer childcareCost); childcare_net_couple_1 and similar replace the OECD reference figure, a year

paidChildcare.description: Whether the household pays for childcare for its children under 6 (default true). false: no childcare cost is counted. Ask when it matters: the default prices full-time care for an OECD reference household

pension.description: Share of your gross paid into a pension, 0.05 = 5%: it leaves take-home pay and is shown as saving, not cost. Tax relief is modelled for CA (RRSP), CH (pillar 3a), CZ (pension savings (penzijní spoření)), DE (occupational pension (Entgeltumwandlung)), EE (third pillar), ES (plan de pensiones), FR (PER (plan d'épargne retraite)), GB (workplace or personal pension), HU (voluntary pension fund), IE (occupational pension or PRSA), IT (fondo pensione), JP (iDeCo), NL (workplace pension), NO (IPS (individual pension savings)), PT (PPR), SG (SRS), US (401(k)); elsewhere it is not modelled and the share is counted as saving with no relief (each city's money says which)

personal.description: Your own 1-5 lines, scores keyed by city

regimes.description: Newcomer tax regime per country, ISO alpha-2 -> regime id from list_metrics_and_sources. None counts unless named here; a named one is a scenario until the person's facts and confirmations meet every condition

salary.description: Your gross yearly salary, the same everywhere

currency.description: ISO 4217, e.g. EUR, GBP, USD. Default: the display currency
ISO 4217, e.g. EUR, GBP, USD. Default: the display currency

salaryByCity.description: Gross yearly salary per city (offers or estimates), keyed by city id or name

savings.description: Savings in the display currency, for runway

spending.description: Monthly spending on everything except housing, childcare and health, which are counted separately

currency.description: ISO 4217, e.g. EUR, GBP, USD. Default: the display currency

homeCity.description: Where you spend this today; default: the first city

stances.description: Where the person stands on the position lines, which score a place by its distance from them: politics 0 (left) to 10 (right); abortion 0 not allowed or only to save her life, 1 also for her health or after rape, 2 also on social or economic grounds, 3 on request in the first weeks only, 4 on request to 10 weeks or later; couples_law 0 criminalised (same-sex relations a crime), 1 legal with no union in law, 2 civil union or partnership, 3 marriage. Pass only what the person told you or what you know they hold; never guess. A stance counts once its line has a weight (they are 0 by default)

flatRate.description: Flat income tax rate replacing the schedule, e.g. 0.24

noSocialContributions.description: You pay none of the country's employee social contributions, e.g. a foreigner on a Singapore Employment Pass pays no CPF

taxableShare.description: Share of gross that is taxable, e.g. 0.5 under an impatriate regime

taxTweaks.description: Per-country tax tweaks keyed by ISO alpha-2

weights.description: Weight 0-100 per criterion, on top of the preset. Criteria: money_left, living_cost, right_to_live, nice_days, winter_light, sunshine, dry_days, clean_air, safety, long_life, health_costs, childcare, family_leave, happiness, builders, time_zone, flight_home, airport, public_transport, rail, short_commute, cycling, walkable, active_commute, way_out, sea, mountains, green, internet, english, international, doctors, jobs, degrees, developers, clean_government, politics, abortion, couples_law, founders_run, coworking, climbing, swimming, beach, run_ride, muggy, grey, hot_nights, heat, snow, wind

name: compare_cities

moneyBasis.description: The money line asked for and the basis it was compared on for every city

notes.description: How this set was scored: a line on another basis or left out for every city, periods that differ

provisional.description: True when missing figures, partial money or money compared on another basis could still change who leads: say so

coverage.description: Share of the weight scored on observed figures, 0-1

verdict.description: Who leads, qualified when a must-pass is unknown, when the lead is provisional, and when money was compared on another basis

title: Compare cities
